commits.message:
fix(export)!: a translucent colour exports as the colour the terminal is sent (rich-style-wl27) (#320)

* fix(export)!: a translucent colour exports as the colour the terminal is sent (rich-style-wl27)

resolveLook flattened alpha over the export canvas while Style.drawnColors
(what toSgrCodes writes) flattens over SURFACE_BLACK. Truecolor SGR bytes are
absolute, so under any non-black theme the export pictured a colour no
terminal draws: #ff000000 sent 38;2;0;0;0 and exported as the canvas.

resolveLook now reads Style.drawnColors, so there is one flatten and the two
cannot disagree. Translucent backgrounds change too: they diverged the same way.

* docs(color): no surface but black is left that an export flattens over (rich-style-wl27)

Review: three comments and one test name still described an export
compositing over its canvas, and colorMath steered callers to pass
exportCanvas(theme).background as the contrast substrate — which now
picks text against a colour the export never draws.
